type: numerical bug fix, before any valid fine-tuning result
observation: The first GPU fine-tuning run (fold LODO_abuzz) reported a NaN mean loss in epoch 0 and was stopped. No model, embedding, prediction or metric was written (results/v4/finetune/LODO_abuzz/ is empty).
diagnosis: The Perch ONNX graph implements the sigmoid as 1/(1+exp(-x)). onnx2torch converts each of its 104 Exp nodes literally. For x < about -88, exp(-x) overflows to inf in fp32: the forward value is still 0, but ExpBackward returns NaN (inf*0), detected with torch.autograd anomaly mode at the 14th step of a label-free probe.
change: v4_finetune.load_backbone replaces the function of the 104 Exp modules by exp(clamp(x, max=80)). exp(80) is finite. Forward values change only where the sigmoid is already below 2e-35. The count of patched nodes is checked at load time.

checks.parity_vs_original_onnx: max |diff| 1.9e-06 on the same 12 real whitened chunks as in A1 (unchanged)
checks.stability: 300 label-free training steps (constant target, random cached chunks): 0 non-finite losses. No development label or score used.
